hook: Prime sunbathing real estate for cats.
caption:
#ad Now offering prime high-rise window space with zero drilling required. This soft plush hammock mounts directly to glass so indoor cats can watch birds in comfort. Just measure your glass dimensions first, as this cozy perch works best for average-weight felines.

Find more on the shelf: https://solvix-shelf.pages.dev/

#cats #windowseat #petperch #indoorcat
brief: Suction-cup cat window hammock: a soft plush seat that sticks to a window with suction cups, no drilling. Gives an indoor cat a sunny spot to watch birds and rain. Check your window size first; not for very heavy cats. Playful tone: like a property listing for a cat's sunny window seat.
